lines.text: In Japan,|you don't hand cash|to the clerk.
Watch.|The money goes here —|on the little [blue tray].
This is a [cash tray].|Your change comes back|on the same tray.
The clerk takes the tray,|never your hand.
No touching.|No dropped coins.|Just a smile.
It started as manners.|Now it is just|how Japan pays.
No tray?|Only a machine?|[Feed the machine.]
Follow for more|first times in Japan.
